# Murman Engineering India Pvt Ltd

> Navi Mumbai firm that helps real estate developers in Maharashtra cut whole-life carbon, meet environmental regulation and reach sustainable finance, with evidence collected on site and signed by engineers. Founded 2025, building on 35 years of construction delivery by Lalit Enterprises (since 1991; 55+ buildings).

## Services
- Murman YIELD: green building incentives. IGBC or GRIHA rating strategy and green FSI under Maharashtra's UDCPR (Thane, Kalyan-Dombivli, Pune and other UDCPR areas; not Greater Mumbai, which follows DCPR 2034). Advisory now.
- Murman SIGHT: digital quality assurance. Photo-based checks of finishing trades, reviewed and signed by an engineer. Pilot from Q1 2027.
- Murman MIX: embodied carbon reduction through lower-carbon materials (LC3, PSC and GGBS cements, recycled aggregate). Advisory now.
- Murman ASSURE: environmental compliance. Environmental clearance conditions, six-monthly reports, C&D waste records under the C&D Waste Management Rules 2025, with accredited EIA partners. Advisory now.
- Murman TRUE: green claims assurance against the CCPA greenwashing guidelines. Advisory now.
- Murman CAPITAL: evidence packs for green and sustainability-linked loans. In development.
